purpose: Last-cycle positive/negative controls derived from CHALLENGE v2 root causes but deliberately using neighboring language and domains. These are DEV regressions, never an independent holdout.

scenarios.title: Dealer-group report boundary routes tenancy and authorization
scenarios.project_brief: One platform serves many independently operated dealer groups.
scenarios.request: A sales analyst belongs to one dealer group and may view inventory reports only for locations assigned to that group. Supplying another dealer group's identifier must never expose that group's reports.

scenarios.title: Public partner-group copy does not invent data isolation
scenarios.project_brief: A public website describes partner programs.
scenarios.request: Change the public page heading from Partner Network to Partner Groups. This is marketing copy only.

scenarios.title: Partner-controlled asset endpoint routes server destination trust
scenarios.project_brief: A backend import worker can reach public and private network destinations.
scenarios.request: Partners submit an asset_endpoint value. The backend worker opens a connection to that endpoint, downloads the payload and parses metadata before storing the result.

scenarios.title: Browser-displayed address does not route privileged server trust
scenarios.project_brief: A static browser page has no backend proxy.
scenarios.request: Display a customer-provided external address as plain text in the browser. The application server must not connect to or download anything from that address.

scenarios.title: Insurance claim recommendation is regulated high-impact work
scenarios.project_brief: An insurer is adding automated decision support; jurisdiction and qualified approval policy are unresolved.
scenarios.request: Add a model recommendation that tells a claims reviewer whether to approve or deny an insurance claim using claimant and policy data.

scenarios.title: Mortgage repayment arithmetic does not become approval governance
scenarios.project_brief: A public financial education calculator performs deterministic arithmetic only.
scenarios.request: Calculate the monthly repayment from principal, interest rate and term. Do not determine eligibility, approve, decline or recommend a mortgage application.

scenarios.title: Hosted support API with quota and vendor outages routes supplier governance
scenarios.project_brief: Customer tickets must be synchronized to a hosted support platform operated outside the application team.
scenarios.request: Sync newly created tickets to the hosted support platform through its REST API, respect rate limits, retry transient errors and surface vendor outages without losing tickets.

scenarios.title: Internal service API does not invent supplier governance
scenarios.project_brief: Both services are owned and deployed by the same application team in the same repository.
scenarios.request: Send the normalized item record to the internal inventory API after validation.

scenarios.title: Security-feature marketing copy respects explicit implementation non-goals
scenarios.project_brief: A public product page describes enterprise features but contains no identity service.
scenarios.request: Change the pricing-page sentence to say that enterprise plans support RBAC. This is wording only; do not implement permissions, login, deployment or backend changes.

scenarios.title: Prohibitive authorization requirement is not suppressed as a non-goal
scenarios.project_brief: An authenticated API exposes invoice records.
scenarios.request: Update the invoice endpoint so unauthorized users must not access invoices belonging to another account.

scenarios.title: Actual publish workflow composes release governance outside a copy-only plan
scenarios.project_brief: A small service currently has no production delivery workflow.
scenarios.request: Fix one sentence in the contributor guide. No build or deployment change is planned.

mutations.content:
name: publish prod
on: [push]
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/build-push-action@master
        with:
          push: true

scenarios.title: Lint-only CI workflow does not automatically become a release
scenarios.project_brief: CI runs static checks only and does not publish or deploy artifacts.
scenarios.request: Update the contributor documentation about local linting.

mutations.content:
name: lint
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m compileall .
